name: HCHANA Rice Serum Skin Beauty Essence 15ml
description:
Apply on your skin on your face and neck with serum every morning and/or night after you cleanse and tone.Place a pea sized amount of Facial Serum onto fingertips. Warm the serum between your hands and spread evenly over your face without pulling down on the skin. 

In every step of skin care always use circular, upward motions with a gentle touch on your face. Don't help gravity by tugging down on your skin and remember that the skin on your face, especially around the eyes, is very delicate. The serum should be completely absorbed by your skin within 5 minutes. 


Benefits: 
Functions:Moisturizing whiting.miracle glow.hydrating 
Advantage:Plant moisturizing serum.day and night use 
Effect:Depth replenishment.emulsion skin care 
Suitable Age:Unlimited.liquid serum.smooth delicate 
Suitable for:For dry skin.oily skin.skin care. 


Will work on Most skin types individual Results may vary. Please Do Patch test before Applying.
